verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for an autonomous research agent, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes one-off runs: you give Marlin a topic and it works autonomously for up to about eight hours, with no documented recurring schedule, cron, or repeat trigger. Its internal 'automated cycles' are steps within a single run, not a recurring user schedule, so they don't count.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
